This decision shatters Ariana’s career and calls off her wedding to Kai, her boyfriend from a wealthy family.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 108 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 51 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: 99 NAMA CINTA 33 [P13]
programme.desc: Talia lives under the spotlight of cameras and the heat of celebrity news. Since her fiancé passed away, she has kept her heart tightly closed. To her, love only brings loss. Meanwhile, Kiblat is a respected young ustad—calm, courteous, and firm in his principles. His life is well-directed—until an incident brings him face-to-face with Talia in a heated argument over a minor accident. They instantly dislike each other. Unbeknownst to them, their parents have long been bound by a promise: to arrange their children’s marriage. When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the nest.

programme.title: Iceland: The Puffin Sanctuary [P13]
programme.desc: The endearing, "comical" puffin is Iceland's national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

programme.title: In The Giant Mammoth Tracks [P13]
programme.desc: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, little-known giant back to life.

programme.title: Wild Portugal [P13]
programme.desc: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

programme.title: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild [P13]
programme.desc: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

programme.title: Wild Heroes [P13]
programme.desc: We follow Auckland Zoo’s bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It’s a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising [P13]
programme.desc: Examine '60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising [P13]
programme.desc: See how stricter rules and public mistrust inspired 1970s advertisers to create some of history's greatest campaigns.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising [P13]
programme.desc: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the "Greed is Good" era.

programme.title: Wild Portugal [P13]
programme.desc: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

programme.title: Wild Portugal [P13]
programme.desc: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs' spring rituals, and Grebes' dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

programme.title: Wild Portugal [P13]
programme.desc: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapore's best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: In his quest to find the best ingredients for his banquet dinner, Adam Liaw visits a colourful fruit and veg market in Geylang and a Michelin-starred restaurant.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: In between some cocktail-tasting pit stops, Adam Liaw discovers some of the finest desserts in Singapore, from homemade Peranakan sweet treats to a sophisticated dessert bar.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw gathers what he has learned over the past few weeks to serve up an impressive five-course banquet dinner to some distinguished guests, including his mother.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore [P13]
programme.desc: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his father's side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

programme.title: Kamala Harris: The Next President [P13]
programme.desc: This documentary explores Kamala Harris's rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

programme.title: Lady Gaga: Dance Or Die [P13]
programme.desc: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life’s challenges — and won.

programme.title: Artist To Icon [P13]
programme.desc: Features interviews with Madonna’s first manager Camille Barbone, dancer Carlton Wilborn, Evita studio executive Lauren Lloyd, plus many more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible interactions with predatory killer whales. The humpbacks also face a world full of human threats, from large container ships, to the impact of seismic testing in the search for oil and gas, now threatening their very survival once more.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOceans' scientists on an expedition to uncover more of their secrets and behaviours.

programme.title: Oceans Africa [P13]
programme.desc: In A 'Tale Of Two Sharks' we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: In Chile's Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bays are magnets for rare dolphins and orcas.

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it’s the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the foundation for an intricate marine food chain

programme.title: The Humboldt Current [P13]
programme.desc: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a study in survival.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines' 'Heavy Haulers' squadron as they're put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 'Super Stallion' choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? S2 [P13]
programme.desc: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 [P13]
programme.desc: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 [P13]
programme.desc: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

programme.title: Wild Heroes [P13]
programme.desc: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

programme.title: Attenborough's Life In Colour [P13]

programme.title: Attenborough's Life In Colour [P13]

programme.desc: Far from just another interview show - this is conversation shaped by experience. Because foreign policy is not just theory. It must be lived. The seasoned statesman draws on decades of diplomacy, law, and international negotiations as host. Don't miss the conversation.

programme.title: ARE YOU THE ONE
programme.desc: Qing Guo Gong menuduh Raja Huai Yang merampas segala harta benda yang ditinggalkan oleh Raja Lu. Raja Sui mengarahkan Raja Huai Yang dipenjarakan dan semua ahli keluarganya dilarang untuk meninggalkan ibu kota.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 3 )
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan hos menunjukkan kemahiran bermain gendang Shigu di Hands Percussion Malaysia. Dua pasukan diketuai Rickman dan Ken bersaing dalam siri permainan gendang, termasuk sesi temu bual bersama ketua pemain drum

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Ho mengarahkan Pinyan menjadi pembantu peribadinya dan Pinyan dibawa untuk menghadiri majlis pengenalan rasmi fabrik "Smile Light". Berlaku sedikit kekeliruan tentang fabrik semasa majlis berlangsung.

programme.title: NO ROOM FOR CRIME
programme.desc: Sai Mun Si, ibu Lok Yee, dituduh mencuri wang kepunyaan gangster Fan Kei dari peti besinya. Fan Kei mengganggu Lok Yee tentang hal tersebut. Ah Jim dan gengnya bertempur dengan geng Fan Kei bagi membela Lok Yee.

programme.title: IN SPITE OF THE STRONG WIND
programme.desc: Tang Chen menggunakan wang daripada Shuo Ming untuk membayar bonus RMB 10,000 setiap satu kepada Sha Zhou, Zhu Ran, Hou Zhi dan Bai Ying. Namun, Zhu Ran takut isterinya menemui wang itu.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Demi menghalang rampasan kuasa Chang Sheng, Zai Xing menukar saham Hotel Yong Xing dengan Kumpulan Nan Tai. Strategi ini membuahkan hasil apabila Ivan secara mengejut menyokong Jia Feng dan membongkar konspirasi kotor Yun Jin.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Chang Sheng mengaku telah menjalankan siasatan dan memberikan bukti penglibatan Yun Jin dalam konspirasi pembunuhan Ivan. Chang Sheng juga menayangkan sebuah video menunjukkan seorang pemandu membuat pengakuan di atas pembunuhan itu.

programme.title: HEAVENLY HAND
programme.desc: Ouyang Zong meminta peguamnya merangka wasiat sebelum menjalani pembedahan membuang tumor otak, agar 23 kedai mahjong di bawah Kumpulan De Wang diserahkan kepada Zhang Tie untuk diuruskan olehnya.

programme.title: 18 AGAIN
programme.desc: Da Jung yang berasa bersalah telah memohon maaf kepada Deok Jin yang menyamar sebagai ayah Woo Young. Dalam pada itu, Da Jung mengakui kepada Ae Rin bahawa Woo Young membuatkan jantungnya berdebar dia mirip Dae Young.

programme.title: ARE YOU THE ONE
programme.desc: Santapan Maharaja telah dicemari dengan racun. Maharaja dan Xue Ji tidak sedarkan diri setelah menjamah makanan tersebut. Sun Yun Er kemudian menuduh Mian Tang melakukan perbuatan itu. Siasatan dilakukan ke atas Sun Yun Er.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Mu Sheng mula curiga dengan Miao Miao, Mujur Miao Miao telah membaca novel itu dan sudah bersedia. Dia menggunakan kaedah baharu untuk mengubah kualiti rambutnya dan melarikan diri daripada syak wasangka Mu Sheng.

programme.title: GO - GO - GO! ( SS 3 )
programme.desc: Episod ini hos bersama Soo Wincci, Baki, Berg Lee, dan Chen Siyu berkumpul di Chopsticks Talent School untuk menyertai siri permainan. Episod ini turut memaparkan bakat luar biasa murid sekolah tersebut dalam acara nyanyian dan tarian.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Chee Kan mengaku kepada Jia Mei bahawa dia masih mencintainya. Bagaimanakah respon Jia Mei? Suatu hari, Jia Mei menerima panggilan daripada Jia Ming yang mengancam untuk membakar gudang fabrik "Smile Light".

programme.title: NO ROOM FOR CRIME
programme.desc: Lok Yee mengeluarkan semua wang simpanan dari bank, untuk melarikan diri ke Korea Selatan kerana takut diganggu oleh Fan Kei. Jim yang terpikat dengan Lok Yee, menyerang Fan Kei sebagai amaran agar berhenti mengganggu Lok Yee.

programme.title: IN SPITE OF THE STRONG WIND
programme.desc: Tang Chen datang ke pejabat Kan Li untuk mengutip hutang. Kan Li enggan membayar tetapi Tang Chen secara rahsia merakam perbualan mereka. Shuo Bing meminta Ye Shouru melantik Yising sebagai agensi PR untuk Kumpulan Nan Sing.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ling Feng bimbang rahsia Zhi Sheng terbongkar ketika bertemu Zi Qian di tokong. Sementara itu, Ivan menghasut Zai Xing agar tidak memaafkan Yun Jin, walaupun keluarga merayu agar jawatan Yun Jin dikembalikan semula.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Li Ping bertemu Guo Qing di hospital dan melawat nenek yang koma. Keajaiban berlaku apabila nenek terjaga selepas diseru Li Ping. Sementara itu, Daisy semakin pulih, manakala Kai Hong mula merasa cemburu terhadap layanan Zi Sheng.

programme.title: HEAVENLY HAND
programme.desc: Zhang Tie bersetuju menguruskan empayar mahjong Ouyang Zong meski diragui kakitangan. Cabaran mahjong diatur bagi membuktikan kepimpinannya. Sementara itu, suasana hiba menyelubungi Situ apabila Jiaming akhirnya mengakuinya sebagai bapa.

programme.title: 18 AGAIN
programme.desc: Da Jung dan Si Ah mencapai persefahaman setelah bergaduh. Si Ah menyedari kasih sayang ibunya itu terhadapnya. Manakala Da Jung juga bersetuju tidak akan menghalang hasrat Si Ah untuk menjadi seorang jurusolek profesional.

programme.title: THE IRON LADY
programme.desc: Permohonan pinjaman syarikat Qian Hi telah ditolak oleh bank. Shi Qin berasa amat gelisah dan tertekan kerana khuatir syarikat Qian Hi akan jatuh ke dalam tangan rakan kongsinya, Vincent.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Pengarang kegemaran Ling Miao Miao akhirnya mengeluarkan novel baharu. Namun, karya baharu "Catching Demons" ini hanyalah sebuah kisah cinta yang tidak bermakna. Miao Miao sangat marah sehingga dia menghantar ulasan yang buruk.

programme.title: LOVE GAME IN EASTERN FANTASY
programme.desc: Sistem tempoh perlindungan pemula telah tamat. Jika Miao Miao mati, ia akan menjadi kenyataan. Pada masa yang sama, Miao Miao menerima tugasan sulit. Untuk kembali ke dunia nyata, dia perlu membuat Mu Sheng jatuh cinta padanya.
